title: Product Administration Flow
description: Admin adding new products, updating product details, and removing products from catalog

add_product: Admin submits addProduct.jsp form (name, type, info, price, quantity, image)
Check session: userType == 'admin'? → if not: redirect login.jsp (Access Denied)
Check session: userName != null && password != null? → if not: redirect login.jsp (Session Expired)
Parse request params: prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice (double), prodQuantity (int)
Call product.addProduct(prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice, prodQuantity, prodImage)
→ Create ProductBean(prodId, name, type, info, price, quantity, image)
→ if k > 0: status = 'Product Added Successfully with Product Id: {id}'
update_product: Admin submits updateProduct form (pid, name, type, info, price, quantity)
Check session: userType == 'admin'? → if not: redirect login.jsp + return
Check session: userName != null && password != null? → if not: redirect login.jsp + return
Parse request params: prodId, prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice (double), prodQuantity (int)
→ Check prodId.equals(updatedProduct.getProdId()) → if mismatch: return 'Both Products are Different'
→ DBUtil.provideConnection(); SELECT * FROM product WHERE pid=?; return rs.getInt('pquantity')
→ PreparedStatement: UPDATE product SET pname,ptype,pinfo,pprice,pquantity WHERE pid=?
→ status += ' And Mail Send to customers who were waiting'
→ else if k > 0: status = 'Product Updated Successfully!'
→ else: status = 'Product Not available in the store!'
remove_product: Admin triggers RemoveProductSrv with prodid param
Check session: userType == 'admin'? → if not: redirect login.jsp (Access Denied)
Check session: userName != null && password != null? → if not: redirect login.jsp (Session Expired)
→ PreparedStatement ps: DELETE FROM product WHERE pid=?
→ PreparedStatement ps2: DELETE FROM usercart WHERE prodid=?
→ ps2.executeUpdate()  [cascade remove from all user carts]

conditions_and_branches: Auth check: session userType == 'admin' (all three servlets)
Auth check: session userName != null AND password != null (all three servlets)
addProduct: DB insert result k > 0 → success / failure
updateProduct: prodId mismatch → early return failure
updateProduct: k > 0 AND prevQuantity < newQuantity → notify waiting customers via email
updateProduct: k > 0 (quantity not increased) → plain success
removeProduct: k > 0 → also delete from usercart (cascade)
updateProduct demand loop: for each demand, send email and remove demand entry
key_relationships: ProductServiceImpl uses IDUtil.generateId() for new product IDs
ProductBean: fields prodId, prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice(double), prodQuantity(int), prodImage(InputStream)
db_operations: updateProductWithoutImage: UPDATE product SET pname,ptype,pinfo,pprice,pquantity WHERE pid=?
removeProduct: DELETE FROM product WHERE pid=?
removeProduct cascade: DELETE FROM usercart WHERE prodid=?
getProductQuantity: SELECT * FROM product WHERE pid=?
important_notes: UpdateProductSrv uses updateProductWithoutImage — image is preserved, only metadata fields updated
RemoveProductSrv cascades deletion to usercart table
updateProductWithoutImage triggers email notification to waiting customers when quantity increases from 0
No explicit transaction management — separate DB operations for cascade delete in removeProduct
Auth failures in AddProductSrv do NOT return (code falls through); UpdateProductSrv and RemoveProductSrv use explicit 'return'
